English: Open Courtyard
A simple, cleared space surrounded by rough earth and wooden posts, serving as a gathering place for prayers and meetings.
Paved Walkway
Rough stones are laid to create a modest path, guiding pilgrims and monks across the courtyard.
Shaded Cloister Walk
A covered wooden walkway lines the courtyard, providing shade and shelter for contemplation and study.
Arched Cloister
Stone arches and columns enclose the courtyard, lending an air of solemnity and permanence to the monastic grounds.
Cloister Gardens
Carefully tended gardens flourish within the cloister, providing herbs for healing and spaces for meditation.
Central Fountain
A masterfully carved stone fountain is installed at the heart of the cloister, symbolizing purity and divine sustenance.
Covered Walkways
Sturdy, vaulted walkways encircle the gardens, allowing uninterrupted passage for monks and pilgrims in all weather.
Cloistered Quadrangle
The cloister expands into a grand quadrangle, with elegant colonnades and intricate stonework, serving as the spiritual and communal heart of the temple.
Ornate Cloister
Lavishly decorated with carvings, murals, and religious iconography, the cloister draws pilgrims and scholars from afar.
Grand Cloister Complex
A vast, awe-inspiring complex of cloisters, gardens, fountains, and libraries, radiating spiritual power and learning across the realm.
